title: Refused payload
description: The model declined to answer: the gateway's chat completion carried a non-empty `message.refusal` (the Chat Completions refusal, `AssistantRefusal` in llm-chat). Its text is no answer: no `delta` is streamed and no tool call it asked for is made. `refusal` is that text, restored under a `redaction` policy; `steps` and the token counts are those of the model calls made, this one included, as for `cortex.ask.ClientClosed`.
